violation_type.title: Parent right to be free from retaliatory action (26 TAC §747.521(11))
violation_type.short_title: Parent right to be free from retaliatory action
violation_type.typical_finding: Parent rights do not include Being free from any retaliatory action by your child-care home for exercising any of the parent's rights  in the operations policies.
